# Sky Tech Builders

> > Sky Tech Builders is a premier home remodeling and construction company serving San Jose, Santa Clara, and the greater Bay Area with expertise in kitchen and bathroom remodeling, ADUs, room additions, and new construction.

Sky Tech Builders specializes in residential construction and remodeling throughout the Bay Area, including Atherton, Cupertino, Menlo Park, Mountain View, Belmont, and surrounding communities. The company leverages 3D design technology for accurate project visualization and estimates, while offering comprehensive services from kitchen and bathroom renovations to complete home remodels, garage conversions, and eco-friendly new construction.
